metadata.description: The brio-faerie leg for an author with no retroreflective tape on the wall: the ir-marker probe (and its eight painting-corner bindings) is dropped, and the faerie probe's painting quad is pinned instead to a hand-authored rectangle on the upper-left wall. The head-anchored faerie and the journey/portal spawn still work exactly as in the basis.
metadata.title: BRIO Faerie (authored painting)
